name.description: the track's name, a few words

location.description: where it is, a town or region

discipline.description: mx an outdoor motocross track, the normal answer; sx a supercross round on a stadium floor; smx a SuperMotocross round, an outdoor lap with stadium sections in it. Only pick sx or smx when the brief actually asks for one

lapLength.description: metres round the lap, 1700 to 2300; 2100 is a national

width.description: the riding line, metres, 12 to 18; 15 is normal

cornersPerKm.description: corners per kilometre, 6.5 to 12; 8.5 is normal, higher is tighter and more technical

apexRadius.description: metres, the tightest radius in an ordinary corner, 8 to 18; low is hairpins, high is flowing

sweepShare.description: 0 to 0.5, the share of corners that are one long fast sweep rather than a tightening turn; 0.22 is normal

jumpDensity.description: 0 to 1, how close the features come after each other; 0 sparse, 0.5 normal, 1 packed rhythm sections. On a supercross or SuperMotocross round it is how packed the lanes are, and 0.5 is what a real round carries

bigJumpShare.description: 0 to 1, how many of the features are real jumps rather than rollers; 0.85 is a national, lower is a beginner or grass track

jumpScale.description: 0.8 to 1, how tall the jumps stand; 1 is full national size, nothing ever over 3 m

waves.description: 0 to 2 sections of waves or whoops. On a supercross round this is the whoops: 0 for a round without a set, 1 or 2 for one. SuperMotocross never carries them

surface.description: sand for a sand track, grass for a grasstrack or early season, soil otherwise. On a supercross or SuperMotocross round sand also lays a sand stretch into the lap

wear.description: 0 to 1, how raced the ground arrives; 0 freshly prepped, 0.55 after a session, 1 a Sunday afternoon

roughness.description: 1 to 2; 1 a national, 2 a rough raced ARL track

hills.description: metres of rolling hills in the land, 2 to 10; 5 is normal

tilt.description: metres the whole plot falls from one side to the other, 0 to 25; 0 a flat field, 20 or more a hillside

landforms.description: 0 to 5 banks and spoil hills around the track; 0 a bare field, 3 a normal venue

elevationChanges.description: 0 to 4 straights that climb or drop on purpose; 2 is normal, 4 for a hillside
